Therapeutic Connections is a unique environment, with small class sizes and personal attention.  We provide an apprenticeship style education for students who want to immerse themselves into the world of massage and bodywork to become a “Licensed Massage Therapist.” Get licensed in 1 year! Classes begin in Fall, Winter, Spring, & Summer.

Find a unique environment, with small class sizes, and personal attention. Join us and start your path to success. 

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT?
Perks at Therapeutic Connections School of Massage

- Job Placement Opportunities
- Entrepreneurial Training
- Human Anatomy Lab
- Introduction to Specialty Massage Modalities
- Professional Development
- Community Participation
- Highly Experienced and “Practicing” Instructors
